name: Nikhil Ghosh
source: Nikhil is a software engineer living in San Francisco, who worked at a startup with Jake and Hannah for a while. He was Jake's roommate throughout undergrad and afterward until Jake and Dustin moved in together. He tends to be a bit scatterbrained, but generally enjoys programming and tinkering with electronics.
